The worktree's own working copy of the log is read by neither side. data.rule: Commit-hook git reads run in the tree being committed (the hook's cwd toplevel, if it belongs to this repository), inheriting GIT_INDEX_FILE; never git -C <primary>. When simulating a hook, set every variable git exports: a linked worktree's hook gets GIT_DIR as well as GIT_INDEX_FILE, and GIT_DIR alone had been masking this bug in real commits.
data.title: A git hook's reads must not depend on which GIT_* variables the runner kept: run them in the committing tree
